Opaque handle representing a single async offload operation triggered during an s2n-tls handshake. The actual structure is intentionally hidden; it is owned by s2n-tls and will be freed with the associated s2n_connection. Users only pass it to APIs like s2n_async_offload_op_perform. Construction is internal to the library; lifetime is tied to the connection and the specific operation instance. Can be used exactly once with s2n_async_offload_op_perform.

Bitmask enum specifying which async offload operation types are allowed/recognized by the callback. Currently defines a flag for public-key verify and a sentinel that enables all present and future types. Intended to be ORed into an allow-list passed to s2n_config_set_async_offload_callback.

objects.definition: typedef int (*s2n_async_offload_cb)(struct s2n_connection *conn, struct s2n_async_offload_op *op, void *ctx);
objects.description: Function pointer type for the async offload callback invoked during handshake when an allowed operation is encountered. Returns int status; on success, the user may perform the operation asynchronously by returning immediately and later calling s2n_async_offload_op_perform(op) from another thread. The op is owned by s2n-tls; do not free it. Must not call s2n_async_offload_op_perform more than once for a given op.

Opaque forward-declared structure representing a TLS CertificateRequest context used within s2n-tls. Only a forward declaration is present in this header; the actual structure layout is private. It is used to access the server-provided certificate_authorities list and to set the client certificate/chain to return.

Opaque forward-declared structure representing an iterable view over the certificate_authorities extension from a TLS CertificateRequest. Only a forward declaration is present in this header; the actual structure layout is private. The list’s lifetime is tied to the associated s2n_certificate_request.

objects.definition: typedef int (*s2n_cert_request_callback)(struct s2n_connection *conn, void *ctx, struct s2n_certificate_request *request);
objects.description: Function pointer type for the CertificateRequest callback invoked on the client after parsing a CertificateRequest. The callback receives the active connection, a user-provided context pointer, and the certificate request handle, and returns S2N_SUCCESS (0) on success or S2N_FAILURE (-1) on failure.
No custom data types (structs, enums, typedefs, or classes) are defined in this header. The file only declares the function `s2n_cleanup_thread`. Therefore, there are no extractable type definitions.

Opaque forward-declared handle used by the CRL lookup callback to reference the certificate currently being processed and to return a CRL decision via s2n_crl_lookup_set or s2n_crl_lookup_ignore. Definition is not present in this header.
Function pointer type for a callback that provides a CRL decision for a received certificate. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

Opaque CRL object allocated by s2n_crl_new, loaded with PEM via s2n_crl_load_pem, queried with s2n_crl_get_issuer_hash/validate functions, and freed with s2n_crl_free. The struct definition is not present in this header.

Opaque forward-declared handle passed to the certificate validation callback, used to accept or reject certificate validation asynchronously or synchronously via s2n_cert_validation_accept or s2n_cert_validation_reject. Definition is not present in this header.

Opaque configuration object for s2n-tls. It is referenced by this header to configure acceptance of custom critical X.509 extensions, but it is not defined here. Details such as lifetime management and fields are unknown from this header.

Pointer to an array of bytes representing an ASN.1 Object Identifier (OID) for a custom X.509 critical extension. This is a built-in integer type alias from standard headers; it is only referenced here and not defined in this header.

Pointer to a 32-bit unsigned integer. Used here to convey the length of the extension OID. This is a built-in integer type alias from standard headers; it is only referenced here and not defined in this header.

Event payload structure describing details of a completed TLS handshake in s2n-tls. Contains negotiated protocol version, selected cipher and group (as static strings), and nanosecond timing data for the handshake including start and end markers. The handshake_start_ns may be set to HANDSHAKE_EVENT_SENT to indicate the event has already been emitted.

objects.definition: typedef void (*s2n_event_on_handshake_cb)(struct s2n_connection *conn, void *subscriber, struct s2n_event_handshake *event);

Enumeration selecting the fingerprinting algorithm to use when computing ClientHello fingerprints. Currently includes JA3 and JA4 variants.

Opaque handle to an internal fingerprinting context used to compute ClientHello fingerprints efficiently across multiple invocations. Only a forward declaration is present in this header; layout is private.
Opaque connection object from s2n-tls referenced by this header. It is not defined here; only used as a handle in the kTLS APIs.
Opaque configuration object from s2n-tls referenced by this header. It is not defined here; only used as a handle in the kTLS APIs.
Enumeration or typedef from s2n-tls that reports whether an operation would block. It is only referenced here as an output parameter and is not defined in this header.

Opaque configuration object for s2n-tls. It is referenced in this header as a pointer parameter to s2n_config_set_npn, but not defined here. Details of its structure and lifecycle are not provided in this file.

Extern constant of type s2n_blocked_status indicating the special blocked condition when renegotiation encounters application data that must be processed before continuing. Only declared here; the underlying s2n_blocked_status type is defined elsewhere.
Enumeration specifying how a client should handle a renegotiation request: ignore, reject with a warning alert, or accept to perform renegotiation later.

Function pointer type for the renegotiation request callback. Applications implement this to decide how to handle a renegotiation request and set the response accordingly. Returns S2N_SUCCESS/S2N_FAILURE.

functions.name: s2n_crypto_disable_init
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_crypto_disable_init(void);
functions.description: Prevents s2n-tls from initializing/cleaning up OpenSSL on versions < 1.1.x. Call before s2n_init() to let the application manage OpenSSL lifecycle.
requirements: Must be called before s2n_init(); returns error if s2n already initialized.
If disabled and using OpenSSL < 1.1.x, caller is responsible for OpenSSL init/cleanup and ensuring EVP APIs are usable.

functions.name: s2n_disable_atexit
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_disable_atexit(void);
functions.description: Prevents s2n-tls from installing an atexit handler so applications can safely shutdown s2n from re-entrant shared libraries.
requirements: Must be called before s2n_init(); returns error if s2n already initialized.
If used, s2n_cleanup will perform complete cleanup only when called from the main thread (where s2n_init was called).

functions.name: s2n_get_openssl_version
functions.signature: S2N_API extern unsigned long s2n_get_openssl_version(void);
functions.description: Returns the OpenSSL version number that s2n-tls was compiled against. Useful for runtime validation of expected OpenSSL version.
requirements: No special preconditions stated.

functions.name: s2n_init
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_init(void);
functions.description: Initializes the s2n-tls library. Must be called once before using any other s2n-tls functions.
requirements: Not thread-safe; should only be called once per process before other s2n-tls functions.
Call s2n_crypto_disable_init()/s2n_disable_atexit() before this if needed.

functions.name: s2n_cleanup
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_cleanup(void);
functions.description: Cleans up thread-local resources used by s2n-tls. Does not fully deinitialize the library. Use s2n_cleanup_final() for full cleanup.
requirements: Should be called when thread-local resources need cleanup; may be called multiple times as needed.
Does not replace s2n_cleanup_final() for complete library cleanup.

functions.name: s2n_cleanup_final
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_cleanup_final(void);
functions.description: Performs complete deinitialization and cleanup of the s2n-tls library.
requirements: Call when finished with s2n-tls in the process.
Ensure no active s2n objects (connections/configs) are in use.

functions.name: s2n_get_fips_mode

functions.description: Returns a pointer to the private key associated with the certificate chain and key handle.
requirements: cert_and_key must be valid and have a private key loaded.
Returned pointer is managed by s2n; do not free.

functions.name: s2n_cert_chain_and_key_set_ocsp_data
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_cert_chain_and_key_set_ocsp_data(struct s2n_cert_chain_and_key *chain_and_key, const uint8_t *data, uint32_t length);
functions.description: Sets raw OCSP stapling data on the certificate chain. Data is copied.
requirements: chain_and_key must be valid.
data must point to OCSP bytes; length specifies size.

functions.name: s2n_cert_chain_and_key_set_sct_list
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_cert_chain_and_key_set_sct_list(struct s2n_cert_chain_and_key *chain_and_key, const uint8_t *data, uint32_t length);
functions.description: Sets the Signed Certificate Timestamp (SCT) list for Certificate Transparency on the certificate chain. Data is copied.
requirements: chain_and_key must be valid.
data must point to SCT list bytes; length specifies size.

functions.name: s2n_config_set_cert_tiebreak_callback
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_cert_tiebreak_callback(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_cert_tiebreak_callback cert_tiebreak_cb);
functions.description: Registers a callback to resolve conflicts when multiple certificates match a domain name. If NULL is returned by the callback, the first certificate is used.
requirements: config must be valid.
cert_tiebreak_cb must return the chosen s2n_cert_chain_and_key* or NULL to use the first.

functions.name: s2n_config_add_cert_chain_and_key
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_add_cert_chain_and_key(struct s2n_config *config, const char *cert_chain_pem, const char *private_key_pem);
functions.description: Deprecated. Associates a single certificate chain and private key with a config (one per key type). Use s2n_config_add_cert_chain_and_key_to_store instead.
requirements: config must be valid.
cert_chain_pem and private_key_pem must be PEM-encoded; leaf first in chain.

functions.name: s2n_config_add_cert_chain_and_key_to_store
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_add_cert_chain_and_key_to_store(struct s2n_config *config, struct s2n_cert_chain_and_key *cert_key_pair);
functions.description: Preferred method to add a certificate chain and key to a config. Supports multiple domains and key types; selection is based on SNI and client capabilities.
requirements: config must be valid.
cert_key_pair must be a valid handle and should not be modified/freed while in use by the config (subsequent changes affect the config).

functions.name: s2n_config_set_cert_chain_and_key_defaults
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_cert_chain_and_key_defaults(struct s2n_config *config,         struct s2n_cert_chain_and_key **cert_key_pairs, uint32_t num_cert_key_pairs);
functions.description: Explicitly sets default certificate(s) per auth method (key type) for use when no SNI match exists. Clears any previous defaults.
requirements: config must be valid.
cert_key_pairs must be a valid array of handles with length num_cert_key_pairs.
Can be called at any time; disables automatic default selection.

functions.name: s2n_config_set_verification_ca_location
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_verification_ca_location(struct s2n_config *config, const char *ca_pem_filename, const char *ca_dir);
functions.description: Adds trusted CAs to the config trust store from a PEM file/directory using libcrypto's permissive PEM parser (suitable for system stores).
requirements: config must be valid.
To override default system certs, call s2n_config_wipe_trust_store() first.
ca_pem_filename and/or ca_dir should reference accessible PEM sources.
Parsing may ignore malformed certs; use s2n_config_add_pem_to_trust_store for strict parsing.

functions.name: s2n_config_add_pem_to_trust_store
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_add_pem_to_trust_store(struct s2n_config *config, const char *pem);
functions.description: Strictly parses and adds a PEM-encoded certificate to the config trust store using s2n's parser, erroring on unexpected data.
requirements: config must be valid.
pem must be a well-formed PEM string.
To fully replace defaults, call s2n_config_wipe_trust_store() first.

functions.name: s2n_config_wipe_trust_store
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_wipe_trust_store(struct s2n_config *config);
functions.description: Clears all certificates from the config's trust store.
requirements: config must be valid.
Call before adding new trust sources to fully override defaults.

functions.name: s2n_config_load_system_certs
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_load_system_certs(struct s2n_config *config);
functions.description: Loads default system certificates into the config's trust store. Errors if system certs were already loaded (including via s2n_config_new).
requirements: config must be valid.
Only applicable if config was created via s2n_config_new_minimal() or trust store was wiped.

functions.name: s2n_config_set_verify_after_sign
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_verify_after_sign(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_verify_after_sign mode);
functions.description: Toggles verifying generated signatures before sending to mitigate rare signing faults at the cost of latency.
requirements: config must be valid.
Consider performance impact; enables additional verification before sending signatures.

functions.name: s2n_config_set_send_buffer_size
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_send_buffer_size(struct s2n_config *config, uint32_t size);
functions.description: Sets a custom send buffer size for staging records. Larger sizes can reduce system calls; smaller sizes increase fragmentation/overhead.
requirements: config must be valid.
Absolute minimum is 1034 bytes; at least 2K recommended. 17K+ recommended for multi-record buffering; consider larger if preferring throughput.

functions.name: s2n_config_set_recv_multi_record
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_recv_multi_record(struct s2n_config *config, bool enabled);
functions.description: Enables receiving multiple TLS records in a single s2n_recv call, reading until the output buffer is full. Can increase efficiency but may block longer on blocking I/O.
requirements: config must be valid.
Be cautious with blocking IO: s2n_recv may not return until buffer is full or peer closes.

functions.name: s2n_config_set_verify_host_callback
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_verify_host_callback(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_verify_host_fn, void *data);
functions.description: Sets a config-wide callback used during X.509 hostname validation to decide whether a certificate hostname is trusted. The callback is invoked with each hostname found in the leaf certificate and should return 1 to trust or 0 to reject. Connections using this config inherit the callback.
requirements: config must be a valid, initialized s2n_config pointer
Callback must follow s2n_verify_host_fn semantics: return 1 to trust, 0 to not trust
data is an opaque user context and must remain valid for the lifetime it is used by the callback

functions.name: s2n_config_set_check_stapled_ocsp_response
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_check_stapled_ocsp_response(struct s2n_config *config, uint8_t check_ocsp);
functions.description: Enables or disables validation of stapled OCSP responses encountered during handshakes.
requirements: config must be valid
check_ocsp: 1 to enable validation, 0 to disable
Behavior depends on underlying libcrypto OCSP support

functions.name: s2n_config_disable_x509_time_verification
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_disable_x509_time_verification(struct s2n_config *config);
functions.description: Disables validation of certificate validity period (notBefore/notAfter) during X.509 validation for this config. Intended for testing/debugging; otherwise has serious security implications.
requirements: config must be valid
Caller should understand security implications and implement external limits on certificate lifetime

functions.name: s2n_config_disable_x509_intent_verification
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_disable_x509_intent_verification(struct s2n_config *config);
functions.description: Disables verification that certificate Key Usage / Extended Key Usage match the TLS context (serverAuth/clientAuth).
requirements: config must be valid
Only disable if PKI intent is known to be compatible despite extensions

functions.name: s2n_config_disable_x509_verification
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_disable_x509_verification(struct s2n_config *config);
functions.description: Turns off all X.509 certificate validation during negotiation for connections using this config. For testing/debugging only.
requirements: config must be valid

functions.name: s2n_config_set_max_cert_chain_depth
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_max_cert_chain_depth(struct s2n_config *config, uint16_t max_depth);
functions.description: Sets the maximum depth of certificate chains accepted during validation. Default is 7. Value 0 is illegal.
requirements: config must be valid
max_depth must be >= 1

functions.name: s2n_config_add_dhparams
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_add_dhparams(struct s2n_config *config, const char *dhparams_pem);
functions.description: Associates PEM-encoded Diffie-Hellman parameters with the config for use in DHE ciphersuites.
requirements: config must be valid
dhparams_pem must point to PEM-encoded DH parameters (NUL-terminated C string)

functions.name: s2n_config_set_cipher_preferences
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_cipher_preferences(struct s2n_config *config, const char *version);
functions.description: Sets the security policy (cipher/KEM/signature/ECC preferences and protocol versions) by name on the config.
requirements: config must be valid
version must be a valid security policy identifier string supported by s2n-tls

functions.name: s2n_config_append_protocol_preference
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_append_protocol_preference(struct s2n_config *config, const uint8_t *protocol, uint8_t protocol_len);
functions.description: Appends a single ALPN protocol to the config's preference list. Data is copied.
requirements: config must be valid
protocol must be non-NULL if protocol_len > 0
protocol_len must be > 0

functions.name: s2n_config_set_protocol_preferences
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_protocol_preferences(struct s2n_config *config, const char *const *protocols, int protocol_count);
functions.description: Sets the full ALPN protocol preference list on the config in order of preference. Used for ClientHello ALPN (client) or negotiation (server).
requirements: config must be valid
protocols must point to an array of protocol strings if protocol_count > 0
protocol_count must be >= 0

functions.name: s2n_config_set_status_request_type
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_status_request_type(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_status_request_type type);
functions.description: Configures whether a connection should request peer certificate status (OCSP) during handshake.
requirements: config must be valid
type must be a valid s2n_status_request_type value

functions.name: s2n_config_set_ct_support_level
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_ct_support_level(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_ct_support_level level);
functions.description: Sets the Certificate Transparency support level on the config.
requirements: config must be valid
level must be a valid s2n_ct_support_level value

functions.name: s2n_config_set_alert_behavior
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_alert_behavior(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_alert_behavior alert_behavior);
functions.description: Sets behavior on WARNING alerts: fail connection (default) or ignore warnings (except close_notify). Ignored in TLS1.3 where most alerts are fatal.
requirements: config must be valid
alert_behavior must be one of s2n_alert_behavior values

functions.name: s2n_config_set_extension_data
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_extension_data(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_tls_extension_type type, const uint8_t *data, uint32_t length);
functions.description: Deprecated. Sets raw extension data for the given extension on the config, replacing any existing data; pass NULL data and 0 length to clear.
requirements: config must be valid
type must be a valid s2n_tls_extension_type
If data is non-NULL, length must reflect buffer size

functions.name: s2n_config_send_max_fragment_length
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_send_max_fragment_length(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_max_frag_len mfl_code);
functions.description: Enables advertising a TLS Max Fragment Length extension value for outgoing messages and sets preferred maximum fragment size.
requirements: config must be valid
mfl_code must be one of s2n_max_frag_len values
Peer behavior may vary; some ignore this extension

functions.name: s2n_config_accept_max_fragment_length
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_accept_max_fragment_length(struct s2n_config *config);
functions.description: Allows the server to accept and honor the client's Max Fragment Length extension requests. Without calling this, server ignores client MFL.
requirements: config must be valid

functions.name: s2n_config_set_session_state_lifetime
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_session_state_lifetime(struct s2n_config *config, uint64_t lifetime_in_secs);
functions.description: Sets lifetime for cached session state used in resumption. Default is 15 hours.
requirements: config must be valid

functions.name: s2n_config_set_session_tickets_onoff
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_session_tickets_onoff(struct s2n_config *config, uint8_t enabled);
functions.description: Enables or disables use of session tickets for resumption.
requirements: config must be valid
enabled: 1 to enable, 0 to disable

functions.name: s2n_config_set_session_cache_onoff
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_session_cache_onoff(struct s2n_config *config, uint8_t enabled);
functions.description: Enables or disables session caching. Requires that all three session cache callbacks are set before enabling.
requirements: config must be valid
enabled: 1 to enable, 0 to disable
All three cache callbacks must be set prior to enabling

functions.name: s2n_config_set_ticket_encrypt_decrypt_key_lifetime
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_ticket_encrypt_decrypt_key_lifetime(struct s2n_config *config, uint64_t lifetime_in_secs);
functions.description: Sets duration a session ticket key can both encrypt and decrypt tickets on the server. Default 2 hours.
requirements: config must be valid

functions.name: s2n_config_set_ticket_decrypt_key_lifetime
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_ticket_decrypt_key_lifetime(struct s2n_config *config, uint64_t lifetime_in_secs);
functions.description: Sets duration a session ticket key remains decrypt-only for already issued tickets on the server. Default 13 hours.
requirements: config must be valid

functions.name: s2n_config_add_ticket_crypto_key
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_add_ticket_crypto_key(struct s2n_config *config, const uint8_t *name, uint32_t name_len, uint8_t *key, uint32_t key_len, uint64_t intro_time_in_seconds_from_epoch);
functions.description: Adds a session ticket encryption/decryption key to the server. Keys transition from encrypt-decrypt to decrypt-only based on configured lifetimes.
requirements: config must be valid
name must be provided and should be randomly generated to avoid collisions
key must be provided with length key_len
intro_time_in_seconds_from_epoch: if 0, set to now

functions.name: s2n_config_require_ticket_forward_secrecy
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_require_ticket_forward_secrecy(struct s2n_config *config, bool enabled);
functions.description: Requires session tickets only be used when forward secrecy is possible (restricts resumption to TLS1.3).
requirements: config must be valid

functions.name: s2n_config_set_ctx
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_ctx(struct s2n_config *config, void *ctx);
functions.description: Associates a user-defined opaque context pointer with the config.
requirements: config must be valid
ctx lifetime should cover its use via getters/callbacks

functions.name: s2n_config_get_ctx
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_get_ctx(struct s2n_config *config, void **ctx);
functions.description: Retrieves the user-defined context pointer previously set on the config.
requirements: config must be valid
ctx must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_connection_new
functions.signature: S2N_API extern struct s2n_connection *s2n_connection_new(s2n_mode mode);
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new connection object in client or server mode. Connection objects are reusable; wipe after use.
requirements: mode must be S2N_CLIENT or S2N_SERVER
Must call s2n_init() before creating connections
Caller must free with s2n_connection_free or reuse after s2n_connection_wipe

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_config
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_config(struct s2n_connection *conn, struct s2n_config *config);
functions.description: Associates a configuration with a connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
config must be valid and remain alive while in use by the connection

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_ctx
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_ctx(struct s2n_connection *conn, void *ctx);
functions.description: Sets a user-defined context pointer on the connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
ctx lifetime must outlive its usage

functions.name: s2n_connection_get_ctx
functions.signature: S2N_API extern void *s2n_connection_get_ctx(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Gets the user-defined context pointer from the connection.
requirements: conn must be valid

functions.name: s2n_config_set_client_hello_cb
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_client_hello_cb(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_client_hello_fn client_hello_callback, void *ctx);
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked after parsing ClientHello. The callback can inspect ClientHello and update connection properties (e.g., switch config).
requirements: config must be valid
client_hello_callback must follow s2n_client_hello_fn semantics
ctx must remain valid while callbacks may occur

functions.name: s2n_config_set_client_hello_cb_mode
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_client_hello_cb_mode(struct s2n_config *config, s2n_client_hello_cb_mode cb_mode);
functions.description: Sets whether the ClientHello callback is blocking (default) or nonblocking.
requirements: config must be valid
cb_mode must be S2N_CLIENT_HELLO_CB_BLOCKING or S2N_CLIENT_HELLO_CB_NONBLOCKING

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_cb_done
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_client_hello_cb_done(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Marks the nonblocking ClientHello callback as complete so the handshake can continue.
requirements: conn must be valid
Only meaningful if cb mode is nonblocking and callback previously returned 0 to block

functions.name: s2n_connection_server_name_extension_used
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_server_name_extension_used(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Indicates that connection properties were changed based on SNI; must be called before marking the ClientHello callback done in nonblocking mode when SNI influenced configuration.
requirements: conn must be valid
Must be called prior to s2n_client_hello_cb_done if SNI influenced changes

functions.name: s2n_connection_get_client_hello
functions.signature: S2N_API extern struct s2n_client_hello *s2n_connection_get_client_hello(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Returns a handle to the parsed ClientHello for a connection. Available at earliest in client_hello_callback. Owned by the connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
Returns NULL if ClientHello not yet received/parsed

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_parse_message
functions.signature: S2N_API extern struct s2n_client_hello *s2n_client_hello_parse_message(const uint8_t *bytes, uint32_t size);

size must match input length
Caller must free with s2n_client_hello_free

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_free

functions.description: Frees a s2n_client_hello created by s2n_client_hello_parse_message. Errors if applied to a connection-owned ClientHello.
requirements: ch must be a non-NULL pointer to a pointer
*ch must be a heap-allocated s2n_client_hello returned by s2n_client_hello_parse_message

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_raw_message_length
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_client_hello_get_raw_message_length(struct s2n_client_hello *ch);
functions.description: Returns size of the raw ClientHello message as received.
requirements: ch must be valid

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_raw_message

out must be a buffer of size >= max_length

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_cipher_suites_length
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_client_hello_get_cipher_suites_length(struct s2n_client_hello *ch);
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of the cipher_suites field in the ClientHello.
requirements: ch must be valid

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_cipher_suites
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_client_hello_get_cipher_suites(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint8_t *out, uint32_t max_length);
functions.description: Copies up to max_length bytes of the ClientHello cipher_suites into out. SSLv2 ClientHello suites have a different structure.
requirements: ch must be valid
out must be a buffer of size >= max_length

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_extensions_length
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_client_hello_get_extensions_length(struct s2n_client_hello *ch);
functions.description: Returns the total size of the ClientHello extensions block.
requirements: ch must be valid

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_extensions
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_client_hello_get_extensions(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint8_t *out, uint32_t max_length);
functions.description: Copies up to max_length bytes of the ClientHello extensions data into out.
requirements: ch must be valid
out must be a buffer of size >= max_length

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_extension_length
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_client_hello_get_extension_length(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, s2n_tls_extension_type extension_type);
functions.description: Returns the length of a specific extension in the ClientHello, to assist buffer sizing for retrieval.
requirements: ch must be valid
extension_type must be a valid s2n_tls_extension_type

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_extension_by_id
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_client_hello_get_extension_by_id(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, s2n_tls_extension_type extension_type, uint8_t *out, uint32_t max_length);
functions.description: Copies up to max_length bytes of the specified extension’s raw data into out.
requirements: ch must be valid
out must be a buffer of size >= max_length
extension_type must be valid

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_has_extension
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_client_hello_has_extension(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint16_t extension_iana, bool *exists);
functions.description: Checks whether an extension by IANA value exists in the ClientHello.
requirements: ch must be valid
exists must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_session_id_length
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_client_hello_get_session_id_length(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint32_t *out_length);
functions.description: Gets the length in bytes of the ClientHello session_id.
requirements: ch must be valid
out_length must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_session_id
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_client_hello_get_session_id(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint8_t *out, uint32_t *out_length, uint32_t max_length);
functions.description: Copies up to max_length bytes of the ClientHello session_id into out and sets out_length to actual bytes copied.
requirements: ch must be valid
out must be a buffer of size >= max_length
out_length must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_compression_methods_length
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_client_hello_get_compression_methods_length(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint32_t *out_length);
functions.description: Gets the length in bytes of the compression methods list in the ClientHello.
requirements: ch must be valid
out_length must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_compression_methods
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_client_hello_get_compression_methods(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint8_t *list, uint32_t list_length, uint32_t *out_length);
functions.description: Retrieves the compression methods list from the ClientHello into list and returns its length in out_length. Only 'null' valid in TLS1.3.
requirements: ch must be valid
list must be a buffer of size list_length
out_length must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_legacy_protocol_version
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_client_hello_get_legacy_protocol_version(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint8_t *out);

out must be a buffer of size >= max_length

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_supported_groups

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_server_name_length
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_client_hello_get_server_name_length(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint16_t *length);

functions.name: s2n_client_hello_get_server_name
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_client_hello_get_server_name(struct s2n_client_hello *ch, uint8_t *server_name, uint16_t length, uint16_t *out_length);
functions.description: Copies the first SNI server name into server_name up to provided length and outputs actual size in out_length.
requirements: ch must be valid
server_name must be a buffer of size >= length
out_length must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_fd
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_fd(struct s2n_connection *conn, int fd);

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_read_fd
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_read_fd(struct s2n_connection *conn, int readfd);
functions.description: Sets the read-side file descriptor for the connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
readfd must refer to an active, connected descriptor
Application must handle SIGPIPE if applicable

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_write_fd
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_write_fd(struct s2n_connection *conn, int writefd);
functions.description: Sets the write-side file descriptor for the connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
writefd must refer to an active, connected descriptor

functions.name: s2n_connection_get_read_fd
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_get_read_fd(struct s2n_connection *conn, int *readfd);
functions.description: Gets the configured read-side file descriptor for the connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
readfd must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_connection_get_write_fd
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_get_write_fd(struct s2n_connection *conn, int *writefd);
functions.description: Gets the configured write-side file descriptor for the connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
writefd must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_connection_use_corked_io
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_use_corked_io(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Indicates managed send IO is using corked IO on this connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
Only use when using managed send IO

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_recv_ctx
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_recv_ctx(struct s2n_connection *conn, void *ctx);
functions.description: Sets the user-provided context for the recv callback.

ctx must remain valid while callbacks use it

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_send_ctx
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_send_ctx(struct s2n_connection *conn, void *ctx);
functions.description: Sets the user-provided context for the send callback.
requirements: conn must be valid
ctx must remain valid while callbacks use it

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_recv_cb
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_recv_cb(struct s2n_connection *conn, s2n_recv_fn recv);

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_send_cb
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_send_cb(struct s2n_connection *conn, s2n_send_fn send);
functions.description: Registers a send callback used by s2n to output data. Callback may be blocking or nonblocking and should return bytes written or <0 on error with errno set.
requirements: conn must be valid
send must conform to s2n_send_fn and support partial writes

functions.name: s2n_connection_prefer_throughput
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_prefer_throughput(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Configures the connection to use larger record sizes to prefer throughput.
requirements: conn must be valid

functions.name: s2n_connection_prefer_low_latency
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_prefer_low_latency(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Configures the connection to use smaller record sizes to prefer low latency.
requirements: conn must be valid

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_recv_buffering
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_recv_buffering(struct s2n_connection *conn, bool enabled);
functions.description: Enables or disables buffering of reads to reduce recv calls. With enabled, s2n reads as much as possible per call and buffers extra TLS records.
requirements: conn must be valid
If enabled, application must handle implications described (partial reads, need to call s2n_recv until blocked, consider s2n_peek/s2n_peek_buffered)
Cannot be enabled if the connection will enable kTLS for receiving
Blocking IO must support partial reads (no MSG_WAITALL) if used

functions.name: s2n_peek_buffered
functions.signature: S2N_API extern uint32_t s2n_peek_buffered(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Reports the number of bytes of unprocessed buffered TLS records due to recv buffering optimization. Not a replacement for s2n_peek.
requirements: conn must be valid

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_dynamic_buffers
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_dynamic_buffers(struct s2n_connection *conn, bool enabled);
functions.description: Enables freeing of IO buffers when not in use to reduce memory footprint.
requirements: conn must be valid

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_dynamic_record_threshold
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_dynamic_record_threshold(struct s2n_connection *conn, uint32_t resize_threshold, uint16_t timeout_threshold);
functions.description: Configures dynamic record sizing behavior: use small records initially and reset after timeout. resize_threshold is the bytes to send before increasing record size.
requirements: conn must be valid
resize_threshold must be <= 8 MiB (as documented maximum)
timeout_threshold is in seconds

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_verify_host_callback
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_verify_host_callback(struct s2n_connection *conn, s2n_verify_host_fn host_fn, void *data);
functions.description: Sets a connection-specific callback for verifying hostnames from peer certificates. Overrides config-level callback for this connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
host_fn must follow s2n_verify_host_fn semantics (return 1 to trust, 0 to reject)
data must remain valid while in use

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_blinding
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_blinding(struct s2n_connection *conn, s2n_blinding blinding);
functions.description: Configures built-in vs self-service blinding behavior for timing-attack mitigation on this connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
blinding must be S2N_BUILT_IN_BLINDING or S2N_SELF_SERVICE_BLINDING

functions.name: s2n_connection_get_delay
functions.signature: S2N_API extern uint64_t s2n_connection_get_delay(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Returns the number of nanoseconds to delay (sleep) after an error when using self-service blinding.
requirements: conn must be valid

functions.name: s2n_config_set_max_blinding_delay
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_config_set_max_blinding_delay(struct s2n_config *config, uint32_t seconds);
functions.description: Sets the maximum enforced blinding delay after sensitive errors. Lowering increases timing attack risk; should be less than any timeouts.
requirements: config must be valid
seconds should be set cautiously per warnings

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_cipher_preferences
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_cipher_preferences(struct s2n_connection *conn, const char *version);
functions.description: Overrides the connection's security policy by name, instead of using the config's policy.
requirements: conn must be valid
version must be a valid policy string supported by s2n-tls

functions.name: s2n_connection_request_key_update
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_request_key_update(struct s2n_connection *conn, s2n_peer_key_update peer_request);
functions.description: Requests a TLS1.3 key update at the next opportunity. The update is sent when s2n_send is called. Currently only supports S2N_KEY_UPDATE_NOT_REQUESTED.
requirements: conn must be valid
peer_request must be S2N_KEY_UPDATE_NOT_REQUESTED; other values will fail

functions.name: s2n_connection_append_protocol_preference
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_append_protocol_preference(struct s2n_connection *conn, const uint8_t *protocol, uint8_t protocol_len);
functions.description: Appends a single ALPN protocol to the connection’s preference list. Overrides config for this connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
protocol_len must be > 0
protocol must be non-NULL if protocol_len > 0

functions.name: s2n_connection_set_protocol_preferences
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_protocol_preferences(struct s2n_connection *conn, const char *const *protocols, int protocol_count);
functions.description: Sets the ALPN protocol preference list on the connection, overriding the config’s list.
requirements: conn must be valid
protocol_count must be >= 0
protocols must be valid if protocol_count > 0

functions.name: s2n_set_server_name
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_set_server_name(struct s2n_connection *conn, const char *server_name);
functions.description: Sets the SNI server name for the connection (client-side). Passed in ClientHello server_name extension. Must be a NULL-terminated string.
requirements: conn must be valid
server_name must be a NULL-terminated C string

functions.name: s2n_get_server_name
functions.signature: S2N_API extern const char *s2n_get_server_name(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Returns the selected server name for a connection (server-side), or NULL if none.
requirements: conn must be valid

functions.name: s2n_get_application_protocol
functions.signature: S2N_API extern const char *s2n_get_application_protocol(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Returns the negotiated ALPN protocol for a connection, or NULL if none.

functions.signature: S2N_API extern const uint8_t *s2n_connection_get_ocsp_response(struct s2n_connection *conn, uint32_t *length);
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the OCSP response received/sent during handshake and sets its length. Pointer shares lifetime with the connection.
requirements: conn must be valid

Returned pointer is only valid while the connection lives

functions.name: s2n_connection_get_sct_list
functions.signature: S2N_API extern const uint8_t *s2n_connection_get_sct_list(struct s2n_connection *conn, uint32_t *length);
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the Certificate Transparency SCT list from the handshake and sets its length. Pointer shares lifetime with the connection.
requirements: conn must be valid
length must be non-NULL
Returned pointer is only valid while the connection lives

functions.name: s2n_negotiate
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_negotiate(struct s2n_connection *conn, s2n_blocked_status *blocked);
functions.description: Performs the TLS handshake for a connection. Returns success when complete or failure if error/blocked. For nonblocking IO, blocked indicates direction.
requirements: conn must be valid and configured with IO
blocked must be a non-NULL output pointer
Must be called before s2n_send/s2n_recv

functions.name: s2n_send
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_send(struct s2n_connection *conn, const void *buf, ssize_t size, s2n_blocked_status *blocked);
functions.description: Encrypts and writes up to size bytes from buf to the connection. May return partial writes. blocked indicates if/why operation would block.
requirements: conn must be valid
buf must point to at least size bytes
blocked must be a non-NULL output pointer
Caller must handle partial writes by advancing buf/size

functions.name: s2n_sendv
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_sendv(struct s2n_connection *conn, const struct iovec *bufs, ssize_t count, s2n_blocked_status *blocked);

count must be >= 0
blocked must be a non-NULL output pointer

functions.name: s2n_sendv_with_offset
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_sendv_with_offset(struct s2n_connection *conn, const struct iovec *bufs, ssize_t count, ssize_t offs, s2n_blocked_status *blocked);
functions.description: Vectorized send with a running offset cursor to simplify handling partial writes.
requirements: conn must be valid
bufs must point to at least count iovec entries
count must be >= 0
offs is the current write cursor offset and must be maintained by caller
blocked must be non-NULL

functions.name: s2n_recv
functions.signature: S2N_API extern ssize_t s2n_recv(struct s2n_connection *conn, void *buf, ssize_t size, s2n_blocked_status *blocked);

requirements: conn must be valid
buf must point to at least size bytes
blocked must be non-NULL
Caller must handle partial reads

functions.name: s2n_peek
functions.signature: S2N_API extern uint32_t s2n_peek(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes of decrypted application data currently available to read without further IO.
requirements: conn must be valid

functions.name: s2n_connection_free_handshake
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_free_handshake(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Wipes and releases handshake-related buffers after successful negotiation and post-handshake logging/recording is done.
requirements: conn must be valid
Should be called after handshake is successfully negotiated

functions.name: s2n_connection_release_buffers
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_release_buffers(struct s2n_connection *conn);

requirements: conn must be valid

functions.name: s2n_connection_wipe
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_wipe(struct s2n_connection *conn);
functions.description: Resets a connection for reuse, wiping all associated state including pending reads. Call after I/O is complete and s2n_shutdown has been called.
requirements: conn must be valid
Should be called only after s2n_shutdown and after all I/O complete

functions.name: s2n_connection_free
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_free(struct s2n_connection *conn);

s2n_connection_wipe is not required before free

functions.name: s2n_shutdown
functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_shutdown(struct s2n_connection *conn, s2n_blocked_status *blocked);

requirements: conn must be valid
blocked must be non-NULL

functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_client_auth_type(struct s2n_connection *conn, s2n_cert_auth_type client_auth_type);

client_auth_type must be a valid enum value

functions.signature: S2N_API extern int s2n_connection_set_server_keying_material_lifetime(struct s2n_connection *conn, uint32_t lifetime_in_secs);
